map.提速算新时长: Computing the New Duration When Speeding Up
map.原曲 4 分钟（240 s）、原 BPM 120，想提到 140 → 新时长 =: An original track of 4 minutes (240 s) at 120 BPM raised to 140 gives new duration = 240 × (120/140) ≈ 205.7 s; the speed-up is (140/120 − 1)×100% ≈ 16.7%.
map.原 180 s、120 BPM，想练成 220 s 慢速 → 目标 BPM =: From 180 s at 120 BPM, to practice a slow version at 220 s, the target BPM = 120 × (180/220) ≈ 98.2 BPM (about 18% slower).
map.变速会不会变调？: Does Changing Speed Change the Pitch?
map.单纯改播放速率会同时变调（快=升调）；要保音高需用时间拉伸算法（如 DAW 的: Changing only the playback rate also changes the pitch (faster means higher). To preserve pitch you need a time-stretching algorithm such as elastique in a DAW, while the duration still changes in proportion to the BPM.
map.时长公式为什么用原BPM/新BPM？: Why Does the Duration Formula Use Original BPM / New BPM?
map.时长与 BPM 成反比：BPM 变大则放得快、时长变短，比例因子 = 原BPM/: Duration is inversely proportional to BPM: a larger BPM plays faster and shortens the duration, so the ratio factor is original BPM / new BPM, and multiplying the original duration gives the new duration.
